# U197 reference-redrawn labels

Updated 2026-10-26. Front audio/music/speaker label and rear microSD/3.5mm/UART diagram label. The exact SKU has no supplied original in the source lookup, so readable same-SKU official print was independently reconstructed under the user's authorization. These final 1024 px wide PNGs and their model surfaces are explicitly `reference-redraw`.

Copy reproduced: AUDIO, 3.5mm, MP3, WAV, Audio Player, microSD, FAT16/FAT32, Max@32GB, SPI, Sleeve / Ring / Tip, N9301, BUSY, Play L:, PORT. C. UART, TXD / RXD / 5V / GND. No product-photo crop, skewed photographic plane or copied bitmap fragment is used. Font and symbol outlines are visual reconstructions. No unrelated HAT/Module artwork is substituted.

- [Exact official photograph](https://m5stack-doc.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/1155/U197-04.webp) — SHA-256 `9b50221301f3cb788044f8d2ef5dbbbf7fb272cd7a0bccef7536b1389f7746ef`.
- [Exact official photograph](https://m5stack-doc.oss-cn-shenzhen.aliyuncs.com/1155/U197-05.webp) — SHA-256 `b23c40f04d12328751417691bc31c3c42d7d5c8ed3fbf20c5dd7a379cd5582cc`.

`artwork:false` removes all labels. [sticker-check.json](./sticker-check.json) verifies exact shared pre-edit physical and API signatures for both Model and GroveModule, artwork opt-out, preserved visual actions, mounting/connector openings, four-wire pose/attach/detach and resource release. Blue BUSY LED stays independently externally driven; jack/card openings and actual backing preserved; no playback/filesystem.

Remaining boundaries:

- Font shapes, colors, small icon outlines and sticker XYZ are reconstructed from exact official photos; no manufacturing-artwork or production-fit claim.
- Packaging, private originals, mappings, source links from the table, vectors, generators and intermediates are excluded.
- No browser, exhaustive face inspection or full suite; original modeled stage retained.
- Film prints reproduce the actual continuous adhesive labels. They do not fill the jack/card/Grove insertion mouths or hide missing packages; physical jack and card backing remains explicit. No file, card, playback or BUSY logic is added.
